subject: Packaging matrix, channel-evidence and commit wiring for AWS private offer
messages:
From: Maya Patel <maya@orbitalai.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Cc: procure@orbitalai.com
Date: Wed, 7 Apr 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Packaging asks for Orbital AI private offer

Hi Soojin,

Thanks for the demo earlier — team was impressed with the latency profile. Procurement asked me to get a bit more granular on packaging before we route the PO through AWS Marketplace. Two asks from legal/procurement: 

1) SKU-level packaging matrix that shows what counts as reserved capacity vs metered consumption (we need this for our SOW and internal chargebacks).
2) Clear evidence we can share with our channel team that shows reseller margin / pass-through mechanics (they want to know how the reseller will be credited when we buy via Private Offer).

We also have a short list of required invoice routes — some of our subsidiaries need direct reseller invoicing rather than AWS consolidated billing. Can you confirm whether Redwood supports invoice pathing for reseller pass-through?

Ideal timeline: we need docs by EOD Friday (2027-04-09) to hit our procurement cycle next week. Is that feasible?

Thanks,
Maya
Maya Patel
Head of Procurement, Orbital AI
maya@orbitalai.com
(415) 555-0192

(Attachment: procurement_requirements_checklist.pdf (pdf))

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Patel <maya@orbitalai.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 7 Apr 2027 13:22:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Packaging asks for Orbital AI private offer

Hi Maya — great to hear the demo landed well. We're on it. Quick answers and what we'll deliver by EOD Fri: 

- SKU packaging matrix: we'll produce a spreadsheet that maps each SKU to reserved vs metered and the billing trigger (token-hour, vCPU-hour, reserved node-month).
- Reseller margin / pass-through: we'll share a short waterfall PDF that documents how reseller commissions and AWS private-offer credits flow end-to-end (including examples for consolidated vs direct invoice).
- Invoice routing: Redwood supports both AWS consolidated billing path and direct invoicing via approved reseller EDI/portal; we'll flag any constraints per region.

Ben, can you include the typical passback percentages and a sample invoice flow we can send to Orbital? Laura — please upload the packaging matrix template to the Drive link below and attach the draft PDF.

Maya — we can meet Friday morning if you want to walk through the artifacts before you send them to procurement.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Director, Marketplace & Channel Partnerships
Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.ai

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Maya Patel <maya@orbitalai.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 8 Apr 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Packaging asks for Orbital AI private offer

Hi all — adding the quick numbers and examples Soojin requested. High level (will include spreadsheet rows with these examples):

- Tier A (Reserved capacity certified): reseller passback = 18% of list price. Example: reserved node committed monthly SKU (RDW-RES-16) list price $10,000/mo -> reseller credit $1,800/mo.
- Tier B (Metered usage above commit): reseller passback = 10% of metered revenue. Example: metered tokens over commit = $50k usage -> reseller credit $5,000.
- Special enterprise uplifts (large negotiated accounts): discretionary uplift up to +4% to support channel enablement (requires finance approval).

Invoice routing notes: 
- If Orbital uses AWS Private Offer and chooses AWS consolidated billing, the reseller credit is issued as a rebate to the reseller and visible in settlement files; Redwood can generate supplemental invoice stubs for Orbital's accounting team.
- If Orbital requires direct reseller invoicing, we can route invoicing via our partner network (requires reseller onboarding and EDI setup; lead time ~10 business days).

Attaching margin waterfall and a sample invoice trace for direct invoice pathing.

Regards,
Ben Carter
Head of Channel Sales, Redwood Inference
(Attachment: redwood_channel_margin_waterfall_v1.pdf (pdf))

From: Maya Patel <maya@orbitalai.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 9 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Packaging asks for Orbital AI private offer

Thanks — this looks helpful. I'm attaching our draft PO and the list of subsidiary invoice requirements so you can validate the routing. A couple follow-ups: 

1) For the reserved-reseller example can you confirm whether the passback is processed monthly or as a post-quarter true-up? Procurement prefers monthly so the finance team can match credits to invoices.
2) We will need the SKU packaging matrix in XLSX format so our SOW lead can ingest it into our procurement system.

I'll review the waterfall with my channel team later today. If you can also share a DocuSign link for the Master Customer Agreement with the private-offer addendum it will speed legal.

Attached: OrbitalAI_PO_draft.pdf, subsidiary_invoice_rules.xlsx

Appreciate the quick turnaround — if there's any blocker we'll set up a 20-min slot Friday AM.

Best,
Maya

(Attachment: OrbitalAI_PO_draft.pdf (pdf); Attachment: subsidiary_invoice_rules.xlsx (xlsx))
